en-us.jp_mall_foodcourt_Opt_Apply: Apply as a Food Court Waiter
en-us.jp_mall_foodcourt_Opt_Apply_greeting: "We're hiring part-time waiters at 1,200 yen an hour, paid daily. The work is counter duty, collecting trays and tidying tables. Six-hour shifts run 10:00-16:00 or 16:00-22:00, on complementary A/B schedules over a 14-day rotation."
en-us.jp_mall_foodcourt_Opt_Apply_done: "You're registered for early shift A, 10:00-16:00, on the 14-day roster. You can switch to the late shift or schedule B in Management's Jobs tab."
en-us.jp_mall_foodcourt_Opt_Quit_done: "All taken care of. Thank you for your work."
